name: Spacing
description: The Porsche Design System provides a consistent spacing system with fluid and static spacing values for creating harmonious layouts and component spacing.

spacingFluid.description: Fluid spacing values that scale based on viewport size, providing responsive spacing across different screen sizes.

values.name: X-Small
values.description: Extra small fluid spacing, suitable for tight spacing between small elements.

values.name: Small
values.description: Small fluid spacing, suitable for general spacing between related elements.

values.name: Medium
values.description: Medium fluid spacing, suitable for spacing between distinct elements.

values.name: Large
values.description: Large fluid spacing, suitable for significant separation between sections.

values.name: X-Large
values.description: Extra large fluid spacing, suitable for major section divisions.

values.name: XX-Large
values.description: Double extra large fluid spacing, suitable for very significant separations.

spacingStatic.description: Static spacing values that remain consistent regardless of viewport size, providing predictable spacing for specific use cases.

values.name: X-Small
values.description: Extra small static spacing, suitable for tight spacing between small elements.

values.name: Small
values.description: Small static spacing, suitable for general spacing between related elements.

values.name: Medium
values.description: Medium static spacing, suitable for spacing between distinct elements.

values.name: Large
values.description: Large static spacing, suitable for significant separation between sections.

values.name: X-Large
values.description: Extra large static spacing, suitable for major section divisions.

values.name: XX-Large
values.description: Double extra large static spacing, suitable for very significant separations.
